summary: Wetour Robotics filed a Form 6-K reporting a 1-for-10 share consolidation approved by shareholders on February 27, 2026, and by the board on May 15, 2026, effective June 2, 2026. No fractional shares will be issued; any fractional share will be rounded up. The company also issued a press release on May 20, 2026, demonstrating its Orchestra edge AI platform with a Conductor sEMG wristband controlling IoT devices, PCs, and AR glasses. This is a routine corporate action and product announcement, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, as this is not a transaction.
